interpretation_guardrails: Level 2 is confirmatory with respect to the already-observed Level-1 control patterns only because this protocol is frozen before any Level-2 predictive results are inspected.
All seven cipher families are evaluated; nomenclator and null insertion are not selectively advanced.
No model grid may be expanded after seeing Level-2 validation results.
A family that fails full hierarchy reproduction may still reproduce individual relations; report relation-level outcomes.
A full hierarchy match is structural evidence for a mechanism class, not a decipherment or proof of historical use.
Reserved control-test units are not used in Level 2.
Voynich test_LOCKED.txt is never required or accessed.

replication_rule.family_full_hierarchy_reproduction: all five operational relations are family-relation robust
replication_rule.family_relation_robust: per-language relation replication in at least 3 of 4 languages
replication_rule.note: Cipher-key seeds are robustness perturbations, not assumed statistically independent experimental replicates.
replication_rule.per_language_relation_replication: at least 4 of 5 frozen cipher keys are strong direction matches
replication_rule.per_run_strong_direction_match: delta > 0 and paired-bootstrap 95% CI lower bound > 0

selection_caveat: All comparisons are conditional on validation-selected HMM state count, slot-template count, token context order, and copy source window, matching the original Voynich workflow; the bootstrap does not include hyperparameter-selection uncertainty.

voynich_reference.meaning: Positive delta means the character trigram was better; values are the already-frozen Voynich validation comparisons.
